thread:
marta-fin: Incoming EUR wire from NordicSoft arrived this morning for €48,200 — bank shows sender = NordicSoft AB, value date 2026-03-16, bank ref CHKREF12345, but the remittance text is blank and there's no PO# on the payment. No MT103 attached. Can someone help identify which invoice to apply? This is blocking reconciliation and customer is asking why it's still open.

devon-support: Do we have a bank advice / SWIFT copy? If not, can we ask the customer to provide the payment advice (MT103) or at least the invoice number they intended to pay? I can open a support ticket to request it. :+1:

cory: I can try a ledger lookup. Quick check returned a candidate by amount and sender: run in prod tools:
```
# internal playground
payment_service.lookup(ref="CHKREF12345")
# => payer: "NordicSoft AB", amount: 48200.00, bank: "SEB Sweden", remittance: ""
```

ops_bot: finance-unapplied: New wire received 1905556667, amount EUR 48200. Tagging #finance, assigned to marta-fin.

liam-engineering: Two quick things we can try to auto-match: 1) fuzzy match invoices within ±1% of amount and same currency, 2) match on value date + last 4 of sender acct (if available). I can run the matching job if you want — will produce list of candidate invoice IDs.

marta-fin: Please run the job, @liam-engineering. Also I already emailed NordicSoft billing and asked them to forward the MT103 or give the invoice/PO number. If the match job finds a single high-confidence invoice, we can provisionally allocate and note on the record "pending remittance confirmation". We need to avoid double-allocating.

liam-engineering: Ran fuzzy-match. Results (top 3 candidates):
1) INV-2026-0897 — €48,200.00 — customer: NordicSoft AB — balance 0.00 (closed) — confidence: 91%
2) INV-2026-1051 — €48,000.00 — customer: NordicSoft AB — balance 200.00 — confidence: 64%
3) INV-2025-3380 — €24,100.00 — split payment possibility — confidence: 22%

cory: INV-2026-0897 looks like the intended invoice based on amount and date. Our logs show NordicSoft previously pays full invoice sums. If you want, I can create a provisional application entry and leave an audit note referencing CHKREF12345 and "pending MT103".

marta-fin: Do it. Create allocation as provisional and set ticket in our finance tracker (FIN-3421). Email the customer copy of the provisional allocation and request MT103 within 48h. If MT103 comes back inconsistent, we'll reverse and re-apply. Also include instruction for them to instruct their bank to send SWIFT copy to billing@redwood.com.

devon-support: I'll update the support ticket and cc finance. Also flagging sales ops so account exec is aware.

marta-fin: Allocation created to INV-2026-0897, note: "Applied provisionally — awaiting MT103 from payer (CHKREF12345)." FIN-3421 opened. Will follow up on response; keeping thread updated. :white_check_mark:

liam-engineering: Logged audit event and attached the fuzzy-match output to FIN-3421. If NordicSoft sends MT103, we should check ordering bank's 32A and 71A fields to confirm amount and ordering customer, then flip provisional to final.

marta-fin: Thanks everyone. If we don't receive MT103 by EOD +2 business days, finance will escalate to bank for an MT103 trace request and request ours to do an incoming consult.

devon-support: Noted — I'll ping again tomorrow for status.

marta-fin: update 2026-03-17 09:23 UTC — NordicSoft replied: "sending MT103 now". Will attach when received and confirm final apply.
